primaryChecks.text: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;
primaryChecks.nextContext: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 本文は村々の広がりの終点として「バアル」を明記する。

primaryChecks.text: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;
primaryChecks.previousContext: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
primaryChecks.nextContext: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: バアル・メオンという複合地名であり、この節のバアルとは異なる地点。

primaryChecks.text: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
primaryChecks.previousContext: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.
primaryChecks.nextContext: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: バアル・ヘルモンという別の複合地名。

primaryChecks.text: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God the LORD’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.
primaryChecks.previousContext: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.
primaryChecks.nextContext: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: バアラはキルヤテ・エアリムの別名と明示される。

primaryChecks.text: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.
primaryChecks.previousContext: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”
primaryChecks.nextContext: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: バアル・ペラツィムという別の地名であり、この地点とは同定できない。
